title: Governed Signal-to-Content: A Local-First Pipeline for Evidence-Based Agent Infrastructure Analysis
description: Governed Signal-to-Content is a local-first reference implementation for monitoring external technical developments, preserving source evidence, evaluating structural relevance, and generating reusable content artifacts inside a deterministic governance workflow. The system separates probabilistic or human-assisted interpretation from authoritative state transitions. Publication remains subject to explicit human approval, while evidence identity, workflow state, and execution receipts remain durable and inspectable.
